description: This file is a documentation markdown detailing the HDMIOutput HAL interface, covering overview, requirements, definitions, capabilities, states, protocols, scenarios, and system integration. It is not executable code but a descriptive documentation source.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported features, modes, and formats of the HDMI port, including version support, VICs, colorimetries, pixel formats, HDCP versions, HDR modes, and other capabilities.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing the HDCP authentication state, such as AUTHENTICATED, UNAUTHENTICATED, UNKNOWN.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration representing different HDR output modes like SDR, HDR10, HLG, Dolby Vision.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the HDMI output, including supported resolutions, formats, and features.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and begins HDMI output operation, including HDCP authentication if applicable.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates HDMI output operation, releasing resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HDMI output port interface.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the HDMI output port interface, preparing for signal output.
